s1.syndrome_frame: A subacute to chronic, asymptomatic, solitary skin lesion with gradual enlargement
salient_findings: Single asymptomatic lesion on the dorsum of the left hand
Lesion gradually increased in size over 10 months
key_facts: Lesion located on the dorsal aspect of the left hand
No history of trauma, discharge, pain, redness, bleeding, or restriction of joint movement
Normal routine hematologic, liver, and renal function tests

raw.syndrome_frame: A subacute to chronic, asymptomatic, solitary skin lesion with gradual enlargement
salient_findings: Single asymptomatic lesion on the dorsum of the left hand
Lesion gradually increased in size over 10 months
key_facts: Lesion located on the dorsal aspect of the left hand
No history of trauma, discharge, pain, redness, bleeding, or restriction of joint movement
Normal routine hematologic, liver, and renal function tests

shortlist.label: Dermatofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Common benign skin tumor matching the description of a firm, well-defined nodule

shortlist.label: Epidermal inclusion cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Possible diagnosis given the lesion's characteristics and lack of symptoms

shortlist.label: Lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Benign tumor that could present as a solitary, non-tender nodule

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: Rare but important consideration due to potential for local aggression and metastasis

shortlist.label: Keloid
shortlist.why_kept: Possible diagnosis given the lesion's size and firmness, although the absence of trauma history makes it less likely

raw.rationale: The lesion is described as a well-defined, firm, non-transilluminating, and non-tender nodule, which is consistent with the typical presentation of a dermatofibroma. The lack of symptoms and normal laboratory tests also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Epidermal inclusion cyst
rejected.why: Typically transilluminating and may be tender

rejected.label: Lipoma
rejected.why: Usually softer and more mobile than the described lesion

rejected.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
rejected.why: Typically larger and more irregular at presentation

rejected.label: Keloid
rejected.why: Usually associated with a history of trauma and has a more irregular shape
